chichani.name: Chichani · Vothic Kingdom
chichani.note: Voth's ruling people (Tzintzuntzan — LORE.md §6.12): ashen-brown to ashen-grey skin, dark hair, amber-crimson eyes; equal ⅓ Mesoamerican + ⅓ Classical Ottoman + ⅓ Morrowind Dunmer synthesis (strictly non-chitin architectural ash-resin & calcined bone-paste armor). Spans Old-Style Heartland Shim/Driyan/Azoth (including Azoth's House-Dres Blïtrit slave-estates & Shumar/Dalab marcher-wardens) and New Inner-Crater Voth/Almua/Zey'danin/Temple Canton (Ordinators, Solar Janissaries, High Priests, Grey Penitents, and Sovereign Tzintzun; 16 tiers at 100% M/F parity; tools/garments/cultures/vothic.py).

voth_arcologies.name: Drum & Torus · Twin Arcologies & Auxiliaries
voth_arcologies.note: Subject arcology chiefdoms of Drum (Vinvolk) & Torus (Rinkvolk) plus Vothic Crown Auxiliaries (settlements/drum/PLAN.md, settlements/torus/PLAN.md, LORE.md §6.12): unassimilated reclaimed-Ancient canvas riggers, Forest-Ring orchard terracers, and collaborating client chiefs bearing reluctant tax-tallies; Mad Max / Fallout "Scrap-Vothic" tyre-tread & welded road-plate militias painted with dripping ash-white Vothic diamonds; and Hetānini Islander bireme marines + Scyvoi frontier outriders in Vothic purple service sashes (7 tiers at 100% M/F parity; tools/garments/cultures/vothic.py).
